characters.continuity: Pokémon games and anime, plus Pokémon Adventures manga
characters.summary: Muk is a pure Poison-type sludge Pokémon that fights by enveloping enemies in toxic waste, emitting overpowering stenches, and executing crushing physical strikes.

mechanisms: Semi-fluid body that absorbs physical blows
Naturally repulsive toxic coating that discourages melee engagement
Poison touch body that naturally repels physical attackers
High special defense and HP pool

depictions.title: Pokémon Red and Blue / Generation I games

limitations: Leaves toxic residue everywhere it travels
Vulnerable to ground and psychic maneuvers

sources.supports: Abilities, moves, and biological traits across game and anime continuities.

feats.claim: Emits an overpowering stench capable of causing fainting or withering nearby vegetation.
Emits such a heavy stench that it causes nosebleeds and can wither plants simply by passing near them.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries
feats.depiction: Pokémon Red and Blue / Generation I games

campaignTags.claim: Can survive and move through aquatic environments without breathing air.

characters.earlierSummary: Muk is a sludge-type Pokémon that fights by covering opponents in toxic waste and utilizing physical poison attacks. Its body is composed of hazardous, foul-smelling slime that naturally deters physical contact.
unknowns: Exact chemical composition of its toxic secretions varies between organic waste sources.
Expanded to all depictions by the Gemini automated pass (owner ruling 2026-11-20). Earlier claims were carried over; new claims are not independently verified.
